g.title: CR-04-light — Change Request verification (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/changes/change_01/verification · viewport 1440 × 1024 · persistent Change header with lifecycle, revision, intent and a single Review-changes action with overflow; one combined decision panel (state, complete passed/failed/pending aggregate, plain-language cause) over a full-width Claims region with one expanded Claim (CLAIM-2: not-ready, verifying, queued Verifiers) between a collapsed satisfied CLAIM-1 and a collapsed failed CLAIM-3 with findings disclosure

g.text: Raise checkout ranking cutoff for high-risk carts
Reject risky checkouts earlier without hurting conversion.

Waiting for ranking test results; PII review failed.
Verification and approval are separate decisions — approval 0 of 1, awaiting m.chen · override not authorized · approving never runs Verifiers.
Checkout stays correct for high-risk carts
eval-gate-verifier v4 · required · manual · test results missing

regression-verifier v3 · advisory · runs on new evidence
baseline-verifier v1 · advisory · runs on new evidence
No new personal data leaves checkout
✕ 2 findings on revision 7 — PII review failed
Secret scan stale — awaiting evidence bound to revision 7
